before.opening: We’re a small team making a big impact. We value self-motivated people looking to push the frontiers of technology to build a better internet. At Fastmail you’ll have lots of opportunity to work in a variety of areas, and to quickly see real impact from your work. You’ll not only become an expert in email, but also where to get the best coffee and hot chocolate!

after.opening: Fastmail has been the leading independent email service since 1999. We’re headquartered in Melbourne, Australia, with customers worldwide. You’re treated like a person with us, not a data point. We’re not serving the interests of big corporations: we are proudly independent.
main_headings: Our values are all about you
